scan_linter_check.description:
Flags assignments (=, +=, ++, for-in targets and so on) to a plain name that is declared nowhere in the script: no var, function, parameter or catch variable. Undeclared assignments create global variables shared with every other script in the transaction, which leads to collisions that are hard to trace. Each name is reported once. Platform variables that scripts are expected to set (answer, current, data, outputs, g_scratchpad and similar) are not reported; add more with the system property ecs.js.assignable_globals (comma-separated).
Replaces the legacy check "NS: For loop iterators \"i\" should be declared", generalized from i to any variable.
scan_linter_check.name: JS-002: Accidental global variable
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Declare the variable with var in the function that uses it. If a platform variable must be set (for example answer), add its name to the system property ecs.js.assignable_globals.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A variable is assigned without being declared anywhere in the script.
